title: The Garden of Rosewater Lane
author: Bram Iversen
blurb: Wendell Galloway, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
